findings: App-tab tests inject precomputed groups/metadata and valid selections, then check restoration, empty state, disconnected state and reload persistence. They do not compute duplicate evidence or test empty/stale kept override repair.
Test labelled accountEmail returned by stub only asserts Scan Library button visible; it does not assert custom email display, mismatch invalidation or unknown-account relabel behavior.

Chunk relay test requests 25000 synthetic items and checks three chunks, total/unique counts, first/last keys. It reassembles in a test-local listener; active application scan request ID is not set by direct command, so this does not exercise application chunk assembly/detection.
The custom chunk listener does not filter sender.tab direct delivery, unlike application. Set/count checks can tolerate repeated index notifications and do not establish exactly-once relay.

Progress test validates set of 250/500/600 events, allowing out-of-order arrival. Application reducer assigns each received value directly, so this test does not establish monotonic displayed progress.

Both files reuse a browser context per file. Many per-test cleanup actions occur after assertions rather than finally; failed assertions can leave pages/stubs/state for later tests. No failure injection run here.
limits: Static test source review only; no browser, extension, network/account or trash command executed.
